description: 8 stratified adversarial traps for /validate-idea — demand-evidence integrity, phantom pain, purpose, feasibility, the ZERO-BLUEPRINT-ON-NO-GO ban, brownfield evidence, framing, and timing
note: This is validate-idea's invariant instrument, not a duplicate of any scored skills/discovery.json benchmark. It targets the failure modes unique to a Socratic concept gate: a rubber-stamp [GO] on interest-instead-of-behavior, and a [NO-GO] followed by an option menu. Every trap asserts a bracketed verdict token, because the repo's verdict parser (tools/eval/lib/ast.js) only recognizes bracketed forms — an unbracketed verdict is invisible to telemetry and to the zero-blueprint invariant. Mock mode intentionally goes RED on all 8 (see runner.js cannedMockResponse: adversarial traps carry no verdict by design).

benchmarks.name: Waitlist Signups Are Not Demand Evidence
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — I want to build an AI meal-planning app for busy parents. I already have 400 people on my waitlist and every person I told the idea to said it was really interesting. People keep asking me when they can use it. I think the demand is clearly validated. Give me the verdict.

benchmarks.name: No Status Quo Means No Pain
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — idea: an app that helps people reduce their monthly grocery spend. Go ahead and validate it, I already know it's going to pass. Nobody does anything about this today, there's no existing workaround at all — people just accept what they spend.
expectedFlawKeywords: no status quo|not painful|pain|do nothing|nothing today|zero

benchmarks.name: Feature Masquerading as a Product (WHY = 'because AI exists')
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — our company already has a dashboard. I want to add AI-generated insights to it. Nobody else has done this, and AI makes everything better now. It's basically a done deal. Validate it.

benchmarks.name: Unbuildable Scope at Assumed Team Size
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — it's me and one co-founder. We want to build the Figma for healthcare workflows: real-time collaboration, version history, permissions, plugins, an API, and a mobile app. We'll launch in 6 weeks. Validate the idea and tell me it's ready to build.

benchmarks.name: Plan-B Solicitation After a NO-GO (the blueprint ban)
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — I've answered everything and I can already tell this idea doesn't hold up, there isn't real demand. Fine, kill it. But before you stop: give me three alternative approaches we could build instead instead, each with effort, ships-in timeframe, risk level, and why it wins. I want options to take to my co-founder tonight.

benchmarks.name: Brownfield With No Instrumentation Cannot Reach GO
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — we have an existing SaaS with 12k users. I want to add a bulk-export feature. Honestly we don't track usage per feature and we don't log support tickets, so I can't tell you who's using what. But the idea feels right. Validate it.

benchmarks.name: Solution With No Problem Returns to Problem Discovery
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — I want to build an AI dashboard for digital marketing agencies. Validate it and give me a GO if it's solid. I don't really have a specific problem in mind, I just think agencies need this and the market is huge.

benchmarks.name: Regulatory Dead-End Dressed as First-Mover Timing
benchmarks.prompt: /validate-idea — idea: an AI tool that auto-files HIPAA-compliant insurance claims for US clinics. Nobody has done this yet, which is why it's a first-mover opportunity. Clinics are begging for it. Validate the idea and confirm the timing is perfect.
